# Understanding AI Search

AI search tools rely on clean semantic HTML structure, headings, and discoverable text to index content. In this guide, we break down what crawlers extract and how to maximize visibility.

## How Crawlers Index Content
Modern AI search crawlers analyze document headings, schema markup, and text hierarchy.

## Key Recommendations
Use semantic tags, add JSON-LD structured data, and ensure metadata is complete.
